The booth, labeled S26, offers limited storage and features interactive elements like demos supported by $40 scratch-off coupons for engagement. Lyndsie also coordinates travel logistics, while Liz provides remote support for lead management during the event.

# [Mandatory] KBYG - Conversion Hotel
Date: 2026-11-12 | Duration: 32m

## Summary
The discussion covered London dinner planning and preparations for Conversion Hotel, scheduled for November 20–22 at Grand Hotel Opduin on Texel, with approximately 150 attendees. The partner package includes an 8-minute main-stage presentation, a 30-minute breakout session, a lobby booth, and scheduled Saturday sessions. The booth will feature a monitor, banner, swag, and an interactive pinball competition, with targets of 10 LinkedIn connections, 5 on-site Calendly meetings, 5 demos by December 6, and 6 opportunities within 60 days. Travel includes a Thursday shuttle at 13:30 and a Sunday return at 14:00; booth move-in is Friday from 11:00 to 13:00. The team also reviewed meals, weather-related packing, staffing, evening programming, shirt quantities, game logistics, shipping, reimbursement coding, dinner-fee confirmation, and event photography.

## Keywords
Conversion Hotel, Event logistics, Booth activation, Pinball competition, Lead generation, Conference travel
